description: OrangeHRM open-source demo — an HR management system. Login, dashboard, and the Admin/PIM/Leave/Time modules behind it.

_inventory_conventions.selectors: Every selector maps to a first-class Playwright locator: [name='x'] / #id (css), role=button[name='Save'] (getByRole), label=Username (getByLabel), placeholder=..., alt=... , title=..., text=... . XPath is never emitted. An iframe-chained selector uses ' >>> '. label=/alt=/title= need page.get_by_label/get_by_alt_text/get_by_title (they are NOT page.locator() engine syntax); role= and text= work with page.locator() directly.
_inventory_conventions.stability: OrangeHRM 5.x is an Angular app. Its `oxd-*` class names are design-system classes, not generated hashes, so they are stable across releases — but `name` attributes and ARIA roles are stronger still and are preferred where present.
_inventory_conventions.verification: These selectors were derived from the app's documented behaviour, NOT captured from a live crawl. Run `python -m scripts.generate_inventory --no-login --urls /web/index.php/auth/login --output app_inventory/orangehrm.draft.json --headed` and `python -m scripts.verify_locators` before trusting them.

elements_notes.error_banner: Shown for WRONG credentials. Text is exactly 'Invalid credentials' — the app does not say which field was wrong, deliberately.
elements_notes.field_error: Per-field message shown when a field is left EMPTY. Text is 'Required'. Both fields empty means TWO of these are present, so a locator must expect more than one.
elements_notes.credentials_hint: The demo prints Admin / admin123 on the login screen itself.

elements_notes.header_title: Breadcrumb heading. Reads 'Dashboard' here and the module name elsewhere — the cheapest proof that login succeeded.
elements_notes.logout_link: Only rendered AFTER user_dropdown is clicked. A crawler cannot see it; it is listed here from manual review.
